title: Crypto Trading Signals - September 06, 2026
top_story_headline: Institutional investors including UBS and Jane Street hold $75 million in Hyperliquid ETF positions
top_story_comment: Jane Street’s $4.4m line is not proof of a directional HYPE bet: Form 13F covers market makers but omits short positions, leaving hedges invisible in the $74.9m gross-long snapshot ([SEC](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/staff-guidance/division-investment-management-frequently-asked-questions/frequently-asked-questions-about-form-13f)). BHYP’s creation flow is cleaner spot demand: 3.66m shares issued versus 170,008 redeemed, ending June 30 with 1,959,065 HYPE worth $128.26m ([SEC 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2088139/000119312526346228/bhyp-20260630.htm)).
